target_customer: AI application developers and companies running LLM agents in production
problem: Teams need one reliable layer to route calls to many model providers and to observe and evaluate agent behavior in production.
business_model: Usage-based gateway and observability platform with open source core; site claims 0% fee on tokens

founders.name: Andy Li
education: UIUC mechanical engineering, dropped out (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Designed parts for AirPods at Apple per YC page.

founders.name: Raymond
education: UIUC mechanical engineering, graduated in three years (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Last name not listed on YC page; taught himself software engineering.

competitors.name: Langfuse
competitors.what: Open source LLM tracing and workflows

technical_complexity.rationale: A multi-provider gateway with fallbacks, logging and evals is solid infrastructure; the later Rust rewrite and 10T tokens per month claim (company stated) raise scale demands.

defensibility.rationale: Gateway integration and logged traces create modest lock-in, but open source rivals such as LiteLLM and Helicone compete directly on features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established from sources reviewed. Helicone, a peer, is described as acquired in one listing.

market_need_then: LLM apps were moving to production in 2024 and needed model switching, cost control and monitoring.

branding.domain_note: Used keywordsai.co earlier; now respan.ai (company blog is blog.respan.ai).

identity.voice_and_tone: Developer focused, benchmark and compliance claims

rebrands.why: No reason stated; coverage describes a focus on AI agent observability. RESPAN trademark filed 2026-02-17 under Keywords AI, Inc.

branding.community_and_virality: Launched an open source Rust gateway via a Launch HN thread per a news summary; the old name Keywords AI collided with SEO keyword tools in search results.

brand_strength.rationale: Rebrand from a generic name that was confused with SEO tools suggests the old brand hurt discoverability; the new name is distinctive but young and no brand press was found.

pivots.from: Keywords AI, AI gateway with observability and evals
pivots.to: Respan, AI agent observability and evaluation with open source gateway
pivots.why: Coverage describes a sharper focus on agent observability; company reason not stated.

outcome_analysis: Respan, formerly Keywords AI, grew in YC W24 into an AI gateway used by logos such as AlphaSense and Whatnot per its site, then raised a 5M seed in March 2026 led by Gradient Ventures. Earlier rounds, if any, are unknown, and the rebrand came as it narrowed toward agent observability.
notes: Seed confirmed by the company blog and SiliconANGLE (2026-03-18). Aggregators cite 5.5M total, implying small earlier funding, unverified. No Launch HN page for the 2024 product found. Competitors cited from YC listings dated by batch only. Rebrand timing differs by source (February vs March 2026); trademark filing 2026-02-17 and funding post 2026-03-18 bracket it.
